name: Speed-to-Lead A - Public form and template reply (demo v2)

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS client_slug, 'web_form'::text AS source, $2::text AS external_id, $3::jsonb AS raw_payload, true AS is_test, $4::text AS test_case_id, $5::text AS name, $6::text AS email, $7::text AS phone, $8::text AS service, $9::text AS postcode, $10::text AS urgency, $11::text AS property_type, $12::timestamptz AS t_received, $13::text AS message, $14::text AS honeypot
), cfg AS (
  SELECT c.* FROM client_config c JOIN input i ON i.client_slug = c.slug WHERE c.is_active = true
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (client_id, source, external_id, raw_payload, is_test, test_case_id, name, email, phone, country, service, postcode, urgency, property_type, t_received)
  SELECT c.id, i.source, i.external_id, i.raw_payload, i.is_test, i.test_case_id, i.name, i.email, i.phone, c.country, i.service, i.postcode, i.urgency, i.property_type, i.t_received
  FROM cfg c CROSS JOIN input i
  ON CONFLICT (client_id, source, external_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, client_id
), inbound AS (
  INSERT INTO messages (lead_id, direction, channel, author, body, delivery_status, meta)
  SELECT ins.id, 'inbound', 'web_form', 'lead', i.message, 'received', jsonb_build_object('submission_id', i.external_id)
  FROM ins CROSS JOIN input i
  RETURNING lead_id
), webhook_event AS (
  INSERT INTO events (lead_id, client_id, workflow, step, status, detail)
  SELECT ins.id, ins.client_id, 'intake', 'webhook_received', 'ok', jsonb_build_object('source', 'web_form') FROM ins
  RETURNING id
), lead_event AS (
  INSERT INTO events (lead_id, client_id, workflow, step, status, detail)
  SELECT ins.id, ins.client_id, 'intake', 'lead_inserted', 'ok', jsonb_build_object('external_id', i.external_id) FROM ins CROSS JOIN input i
  RETURNING id
), skipped_event AS (
  INSERT INTO events (lead_id, client_id, workflow, step, status, detail)
  SELECT NULL, c.id, 'intake', 'idempotent_skip', 'skip', jsonb_build_object('external_id', i.external_id)
  FROM cfg c CROSS JOIN input i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
  RETURNING id
)
, resolved AS (
  SELECT ins.id, ins.client_id, true AS inserted FROM ins
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.id, l.client_id, false AS inserted
  FROM leads l
  JOIN cfg c ON c.id = l.client_id
  CROSS JOIN input i
  WHERE l.source = i.source AND l.external_id = i.external_id
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
)
SELECT
  r.id AS lead_id, r.inserted, r.client_id, i.source, i.external_id, i.raw_payload, i.is_test, i.test_case_id,
  i.name, i.email, i.phone, c.country, i.service, i.postcode, i.urgency, i.property_type,
  i.t_received, i.message, i.honeypot, c.client_name, c.timezone, c.service_areas,
  c.required_fields, c.hot_urgencies, c.business_hours, c.booking_url, c.from_name,
  c.from_email, c.after_hours_note, c.fallback_subject, c.fallback_body, c.reply_signature, c.settings
FROM input i
JOIN cfg c ON true
JOIN resolved r ON true;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { accepted: true, status: $json.inserted ? 'received' : 'already_received', lead_id: $json.lead_id ?? null, message: 'Your request has been recorded.' } }}

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT l.*, c.client_name, c.timezone, c.service_areas, c.required_fields, c.hot_urgencies, c.business_hours, c.booking_url, c.from_name, c.from_email, c.owner_email, c.after_hours_note, c.fallback_subject, c.fallback_body, c.reply_signature, c.settings, COALESCE(l.raw_payload->>'message', '') AS lead_message, COALESCE(l.raw_payload->>'honeypot', '') AS honeypot_value
  FROM leads l JOIN client_config c ON c.id = l.client_id
  WHERE l.id = $1::uuid AND $2::boolean = true
), spam_check AS (
  SELECT x.*, (NULLIF(trim(x.honeypot_value), '') IS NOT NULL OR (SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches(x.lead_message, 'https?://', 'gi')) > 2 OR x.lead_message ~* '\m(seo|backlink|guest[[:space:]]+post|lead[[:space:]]+generation)\M') AS is_spam
  FROM ctx x
), dupe AS (
  SELECT x.*, d.id AS duplicate_lead_id
  FROM spam_check x LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT l2.id FROM leads l2 WHERE NOT x.is_spam AND l2.client_id = x.client_id AND l2.dedupe_key = x.dedupe_key AND l2.id <> x.id AND l2.status <> 'rejected' AND l2.t_received >= x.t_received - interval '24 hours' AND l2.t_received <= x.t_received ORDER BY l2.t_received DESC LIMIT 1
  ) d ON true
), local_clock AS (
  SELECT d.*, CASE WHEN d.is_test AND d.raw_payload #>> '{_test,clock_local}' IS NOT NULL THEN (d.raw_payload #>> '{_test,clock_local}')::timestamp ELSE d.t_received AT TIME ZONE d.timezone END AS local_received
  FROM dupe d
), day_clock AS (
  SELECT x.*, CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM x.local_received)::int WHEN 1 THEN 'mon' WHEN 2 THEN 'tue' WHEN 3 THEN 'wed' WHEN 4 THEN 'thu' WHEN 5 THEN 'fri' WHEN 6 THEN 'sat' ELSE 'sun' END AS day_key,
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(x.settings->'demo_recipient_allowlist') = 'array' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(x.settings->'demo_recipient_allowlist') allowed(value) WHERE lower(trim(allowed.value)) = lower(x.email)) ELSE false END AS recipient_allowed
  FROM local_clock x
), evaluated AS (
  SELECT x.*,
    CASE WHEN x.is_spam THEN 'spam' WHEN x.duplicate_lead_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'duplicate' WHEN x.postcode_area IS NOT NULL AND NOT (x.postcode_area = ANY(x.service_areas)) THEN 'out_of_area' WHEN NOT x.recipient_allowed THEN 'suppressed' END AS final_reject_reason,
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(x.business_hours->x.day_key, '[]'::jsonb)) hours(period) WHERE x.local_received::time >= (hours.period->>0)::time AND x.local_received::time < (hours.period->>1)::time) AS after_hours,
    (SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(r.field ORDER BY r.ordinality), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM unnest(x.required_fields) WITH ORDINALITY r(field, ordinality) WHERE CASE r.field WHEN 'service' THEN NULLIF(trim(x.service), '') IS NULL WHEN 'postcode' THEN x.postcode_area IS NULL WHEN 'urgency' THEN x.urgency IS NULL OR x.urgency = 'unknown' WHEN 'property_type' THEN NULLIF(trim(x.property_type), '') IS NULL WHEN 'phone' THEN x.phone IS NULL ELSE false END) AS missing
  FROM day_clock x
), decision AS (
  SELECT e.*, CASE WHEN e.final_reject_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'COLD' WHEN cardinality(e.missing) = 0 AND e.urgency = ANY(e.hot_urgencies) THEN 'HOT' ELSE 'WARM' END AS final_score,
    CASE WHEN e.final_reject_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'rejected:' || e.final_reject_reason WHEN cardinality(e.missing) > 0 THEN 'missing:' || array_to_string(e.missing, ',') WHEN e.urgency = ANY(e.hot_urgencies) THEN 'in_area+urgent+complete' ELSE 'in_area+complete' END AS final_score_reason
  FROM evaluated e
), update_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l SET status = CASE WHEN d.final_reject_reason IS NULL THEN 'processing' ELSE 'rejected' END, reject_reason = d.final_reject_reason, duplicate_of = d.duplicate_lead_id, score = d.final_score, score_reason = d.final_score_reason, missing_fields = CASE WHEN d.final_reject_reason IS NULL THEN d.missing ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END, is_after_hours = CASE WHEN d.final_reject_reason IS NULL THEN d.after_hours ELSE false END, reply_mode = CASE WHEN d.final_reject_reason IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'none' END
  FROM decision d WHERE l.id = d.id RETURNING l.id, l.status
), duplicate_message AS (
  INSERT INTO messages (lead_id, direction, channel, author, body, delivery_status, meta)
  SELECT d.duplicate_lead_id, 'inbound', 'web_form', 'lead', d.lead_message, 'received', jsonb_build_object('duplicate_lead_id', d.id) FROM decision d WHERE d.final_reject_reason = 'duplicate'
  RETURNING lead_id
), audit AS (
  INSERT INTO events (lead_id, client_id, workflow, step, status, detail)
  SELECT d.id, d.client_id, 'intake', e.step, e.event_status, e.detail
  FROM decision d CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (1, 'guard_spam'::text, CASE WHEN d.is_spam THEN 'fail' ELSE 'ok' END::text, jsonb_build_object('matched', d.is_spam, 'reason', CASE WHEN d.is_spam THEN 'honeypot_url_or_keyword' ELSE NULL END), true),
    (2, 'guard_duplicate'::text, CASE WHEN d.duplicate_lead_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END::text, jsonb_build_object('duplicate_of', d.duplicate_lead_id), NOT d.is_spam),
    (3, 'guard_area'::text, CASE WHEN d.postcode_area IS NOT NULL AND NOT (d.postcode_area = ANY(d.service_areas)) THEN 'fail' ELSE 'ok' END::text, jsonb_build_object('postcode_area', d.postcode_area), NOT d.is_spam AND d.duplicate_lead_id IS NULL),
    (4, 'guard_hours'::text, 'ok'::text, jsonb_build_object('is_after_hours', d.after_hours), d.final_reject_reason IS NULL),
    (5, 'scored'::text, 'ok'::text, jsonb_build_object('score', d.final_score, 'score_reason', d.final_score_reason, 'missing_fields', d.missing), d.final_reject_reason IS NULL),
    (6, 'lead_rejected'::text, 'ok'::text, jsonb_build_object('reject_reason', d.final_reject_reason), d.final_reject_reason IS NOT NULL)
  ) AS e(ordinality, step, event_status, detail, should_log)
  WHERE e.should_log ORDER BY e.ordinality
)
SELECT d.id AS lead_id, d.client_id, d.name, d.email, d.phone, d.service, d.postcode, d.postcode_area, d.urgency, d.property_type, d.lead_message AS message, d.score, d.score_reason, d.missing AS missing_fields, d.after_hours AS is_after_hours, d.client_name, d.timezone, d.booking_url, d.from_name, d.from_email, d.after_hours_note, d.fallback_subject, d.fallback_body, d.reply_signature
FROM decision d JOIN update_lead u ON u.id = d.id WHERE u.status = 'processing';

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Insert lead and inbound audit').first().json.lead_id, $('Insert lead and inbound audit').first().json.inserted ] }}

smtp.name: SELECT YOUR TESTED GMAIL SMTP CREDENTIAL

parameters.query: WITH args AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS lead_id, $2::text AS subject, $3::text AS body, $4::text AS provider_message_id), updated AS (UPDATE leads SET status = 'replied', t_first_reply = GREATEST(clock_timestamp(), t_received) WHERE id = (SELECT lead_id FROM args) RETURNING id, client_id, status, t_first_reply), msg AS (INSERT INTO messages (lead_id, direction, channel, author, subject, body, provider, provider_message_id, delivery_status, sent_at) SELECT u.id, 'outbound', 'email', 'template', a.subject, a.body, 'smtp', a.provider_message_id, 'sent', u.t_first_reply FROM updated u CROSS JOIN args a RETURNING lead_id), reply_event AS (INSERT INTO events (lead_id, client_id, workflow, step, status, detail) SELECT u.id, u.client_id, 'intake', 'reply_sent', 'ok', jsonb_build_object('provider', 'smtp', 'accepted_at', u.t_first_reply) FROM updated u RETURNING id), complete_event AS (INSERT INTO events (lead_id, client_id, workflow, step, status) SELECT u.id, u.client_id, 'intake', 'completed', 'ok' FROM updated u RETURNING id) SELECT updated.id AS lead_id, updated.status, updated.t_first_reply FROM updated;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Build template reply').first().json.lead_id, $('Build template reply').first().json.reply_subject, $('Build template reply').first().json.reply_body, $json.messageId ?? null] }}

parameters.query: WITH args AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS lead_id, $2::text AS failure), updated AS (UPDATE leads SET status = 'failed' WHERE id = (SELECT lead_id FROM args) AND t_first_reply IS NULL RETURNING id, client_id), failure_event AS (INSERT INTO events (lead_id, client_id, workflow, step, status, error, detail) SELECT u.id, u.client_id, 'intake', 'reply_sent', 'fail', a.failure, jsonb_build_object('provider', 'smtp') FROM updated u CROSS JOIN args a RETURNING id) SELECT id AS lead_id, status FROM updated JOIN leads USING (id);

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'SMTP send failed for Speed-to-Lead lead ' + $('Build template reply').first().json.lead_id }}

parameters.query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE leads SET reply_mode = 'fallback' WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'processing' RETURNING id, client_id), event_log AS (INSERT INTO events (lead_id, client_id, workflow, step, status, detail) SELECT id, client_id, 'intake', 'reply_built', 'ok', jsonb_build_object('reply_mode', 'fallback') FROM updated RETURNING id) SELECT id AS lead_id FROM updated;
